mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT lc.implementer_id AS userId, lc.implementer_nm AS userName, NULL AS userPassword, lc.implementer_email AS userEmail, 1 AS createdBy, #{createdDate} AS createdTime FROM ltis_charge lc LEFT JOIN user u ON lc.implementer_id = u.user_id WHERE u.seq IS NULL and lc.implementer_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lc.judg_seq, lc.implementer_id LIMIT #{_skiprows}, #{_pagesize}

SELECT DISTINCT lc.charge_id AS userId, lc.charge_nm AS userName, NULL AS userPassword, lc.charge_email AS userEmail, 1 AS createdBy, #{createdDate} AS createdTime FROM ltis_charge lc LEFT JOIN user u ON lc.charge_id = u.user_id WHERE u.seq IS NULL ORDER BY lc.judg_seq, lc.charge_id LIMIT #{_skiprows}, #{_pagesize}
select seq from user_role where user_role_name = 'IMPLEMENTER'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (user_email, user_name, user_id, user_password, created_by, created_time) VALUES (#{userEmail}, #{userName}, #{userId}, #{userPassword}, #{createdBy}, #{createdTime})
INSERT INTO user_role_mapping (user_seq, role_seq, created_by, created_time) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{roleSeq}, #{roleMappingCreatedBy}, #{roleMappingCreatedTime})
